scope: Qualification of one exact publisher-distributed, root-raw-accepted Android package for future overseas-mainstream blackbox testing; no static, install, cold-start, device or test PASS by this review.

exact_package.checks: Retained staging APK independently rehashed and matches CANDIDATE, HANDOFF and root raw admission; local aapt2 badging and accepted raw receipt match package and version. Raw admission is supplemental official host raw only.

market_and_source_evidence.google_play: Current primary Play listing at exact package ID shows AdGuard VPN — private proxy, publisher AdGuard Software Limited, and 10M+ cumulative downloads. This listing-level metric does not establish installs of exact 2.16.4 bytes or Play delivery equivalence.
market_and_source_evidence.publisher_repository: Publisher README explicitly says AdGuard VPN for Android is not open source and this repository is an open bug tracker. Public protocol/component projects do not supply a verified buildable source tree for the exact client APK.
market_and_source_evidence.release_history: Publisher's Android release history lists version 2.16.4; accepted APK manifest reports 2.16.4.

version_boundary: Official marketing page reported 2.16.68.1 while the exact downloaded APK and official release history report 2.16.4. Cause remains unresolved; this review qualifies only the root-accepted 2.16.4 SHA, not a 2.16.68.1 artifact or current Play-delivered bytes.
identity_limit: No independently publisher-published APK SHA or signer certificate pin is established. Official distribution chain, verified observed APK signer and root exact-byte admission support test-input qualification, not stronger publisher-byte attestation.
